payload.title: Registered shopper buys mugs and a gift item with SAVE10 and receives confirmation
payload.custom_preconds:
A registered shopper searches, builds a cart, applies SAVE10, pays with an approved sandbox token and receives a confirmed order, email and history entry.
GIVEN the HarborCart test environment is reset (stock, orders, promotion redemptions, queues, payment sandbox)
AND the clock is frozen at "2026-10-01T12:00:00Z"
AND the catalog contains MUG-RED (ACTIVE, $24.00, stock 5) and GIFT-001 (ACTIVE, $15.00, stock 20)
AND promotion SAVE10 is active
AND registered shopper "S1" with a unique email is signed in with an empty cart

custom_steps_separated.content: WHEN S1 searches the catalog for "mug-red"
custom_steps_separated.expected: THEN MUG-RED appears in the search results

custom_steps_separated.content: WHEN S1 opens the MUG-RED product details
custom_steps_separated.expected: THEN the page shows SKU "MUG-RED", its name, description, price $24.00 and a stock status

custom_steps_separated.content:
WHEN S1 adds MUG-RED with quantity 2 to the cart
AND S1 searches for "GIFT-001" and adds GIFT-001 with quantity 1 to the cart
custom_steps_separated.expected: THEN the cart shows MUG-RED × 2 and GIFT-001 × 1

custom_steps_separated.content: WHEN S1 proceeds to checkout, enters the address "Pat Shopper, 100 Harbor St, Boston, MA 02110" with S1's email, and applies promotion code "SAVE10"
custom_steps_separated.expected:
THEN the quote shows merchandise $63.00, discount $4.80, shipping $0.00, tax $3.64 and total $61.84
AND the quote expiresAt is "2026-10-01T12:10:00Z"

custom_steps_separated.content: WHEN S1 confirms the quote and pays through the sandbox card widget, which yields token "tok_approve"
custom_steps_separated.expected:
THEN S1 sees an order confirmation with an order number and total $61.84
AND the test API shows exactly one CONFIRMED order for S1 with a payment reference
AND the test API shows exactly one payment attempt, AUTHORIZED for 6184 cents
AND the reservation is ALLOCATED and available stock is MUG-RED 3 and GIFT-001 19
AND S1's cart no longer contains MUG-RED or GIFT-001
AND event capture shows exactly one OrderConfirmed event for the order
AND eventually, within the configured async deadline, the sandbox email provider holds exactly one confirmation email to S1's email

custom_steps_separated.content: WHEN S1 opens order history
custom_steps_separated.expected: THEN the new order is listed first with total $61.84 and status CONFIRMED

GIVEN the HarborCart test environment is reset (stock, orders, promotion redemptions, queues, payment sandbox)
AND the catalog contains BAG-BLUE (ACTIVE, $49.99, stock 1)
AND guest shopper "G1" has a new browser session and a unique email

custom_steps_separated.content: WHEN G1 adds BAG-BLUE with quantity 1 to the session cart without signing in
custom_steps_separated.expected: THEN the session cart shows BAG-BLUE × 1

custom_steps_separated.content: WHEN G1 checks out with the address "Pat Shopper, 100 Harbor St, Boston, MA 02110", G1's email and no promotion code
custom_steps_separated.expected: THEN the quote shows merchandise $49.99, discount $0.00, shipping $8.00, tax $3.62 and total $61.61

custom_steps_separated.content: WHEN G1 pays with sandbox token "tok_approve"
custom_steps_separated.expected:
THEN G1 sees an order confirmation with an order number and total $61.61
AND the test API shows one CONFIRMED guest order and BAG-BLUE available stock 0

custom_steps_separated.content: WHEN G1, in a new browser session, requests an order lookup with the order number and G1's email
custom_steps_separated.expected: THEN eventually, within the configured async deadline, a one-time verification code is delivered to G1's email in the sandbox email provider

custom_steps_separated.content: WHEN G1 submits the order number, G1's email and the verification code
custom_steps_separated.expected: THEN G1 sees the order with BAG-BLUE × 1 and total $61.61

custom_steps_separated.content: WHEN G1 submits the same verification code a second time

payload.title: Payment timeout stays pending until reconciliation, without a second charge
payload.custom_preconds:
A payment times out, stays pending with stock held, a retry with the same key causes no second charge, and reconciliation settles it to CONFIRMED or FAILED with consistent stock.
GIVEN the HarborCart test environment is reset (stock, orders, promotion redemptions, queues, payment sandbox)
AND the catalog contains MUG-RED (ACTIVE, $24.00, stock 5)
AND registered shopper "S1" is signed in with a cart containing MUG-RED × 2
AND S1 has a valid quote q1 for address "Pat Shopper, 100 Harbor St, Boston, MA 02110" with no promotion and total $59.50

custom_steps_separated.content: WHEN S1 submits checkout for q1 with token "tok_timeout" and Idempotency-Key K1
custom_steps_separated.expected:
THEN the response is 202
AND S1 sees a pending payment state and no order confirmation
AND GET /api/v1/checkout/requests/K1 returns state UNKNOWN
AND the test API shows the payment attempt UNKNOWN and the reservation HELD

custom_steps_separated.content: WHEN S1 retries the same request with Idempotency-Key K1
custom_steps_separated.expected:
THEN the response is the original 202 response
AND the test API shows exactly one payment attempt for K1

custom_steps_separated.content: WHEN the reconciliation trigger runs
custom_steps_separated.expected:
THEN eventually, within the configured async deadline, GET /api/v1/checkout/requests/K1 returns CONFIRMED or FAILED
AND if CONFIRMED, exactly one CONFIRMED order exists, the reservation is ALLOCATED, MUG-RED available stock is 3 and exactly one OrderConfirmed event is captured
AND if FAILED, no order exists, the reservation is RELEASED and MUG-RED available stock is 5
AND the test API still shows exactly one payment attempt for K1
